g.text: Two portals and an API on Azure Container Apps, four Foundry agents, and Foundry IQ on Azure AI Search. A recruiter decides every outcome.
Microsoft Entra ID sign-in for both portals (built-in Container Apps authentication)
Foundry IQ on Azure AI Search
Human in the loop: the evaluator and the reviewer only advise. The recruiter approves or rejects each candidate and the decision is stored with the AI rating.
Resumes pass a prompt shield before scoring. Cosmos DB and Storage accept private-endpoint traffic only, and the data and AI services use Microsoft Entra ID (keys disabled).
